prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The left rear quarter panel and rear door show scraping and a crease running along the lower body line, which fits the sideswipe described during the lane change. Damage to the rear bumper cover corner is consistent with the same contact point. Nothing I found suggests earlier damage to this vehicle, and the parts and charges on the bills show no repeated entries. Labor hours look a little high for the work listed, so I recommend a line-by-line review before approval. Repair plan: replace the rear bumper cover, repair and refinish the quarter panel and door, and recheck alignment of the rear door hinge.
